import api
def run(name="Miller"):
    out=[]
    res=api.searchEmployees(name=name)
    assert res['status']==200
    items=res['body']['items']
    page=1
    for it in items:
        e=api.getEmployee(it['id'])
        assert e['status']==200
        b=e['body']; s=b['status']
        if b['lastName']!=name: continue
        if s=='working':
            r=api.giveNotice(b['id'],{},if_match=e['etag'])
        elif s=='on notice':
            r=api.dismiss(b['id'],if_match=e['etag'])
        else:
            out.append((b['id'],s,'left')); continue
        assert r['status'] in (200,204),r
        out.append((b['id'],s,r['status']))
    return out
print(run())
